nodes.label: Systems Inspector App Icon
nodes.rationale: Photorealistic warehouse pallet-racking scene is used as the iOS app icon so the product is immediately readable as an industrial racking inspection tool rather than a generic warehouse or logistics app.

nodes.label: Mixed Bay Occupancy
nodes.rationale: Loaded, partially loaded, and empty beam levels are shown together to read as a working warehouse rather than a fully packed product shot.

nodes.label: Selective Pallet Racking
nodes.rationale: Front-elevation view of a multi-bay selective pallet rack is the hero subject of the launch artwork, establishing racking as the primary inspected asset.

nodes.label: Launch Icon Rack Scene
nodes.rationale: Photorealistic CGI of industrial selective pallet racking on a neutral studio backdrop, used as the iOS launch icon to communicate the app's warehouse racking-inspection domain rather than an abstract glyph.
